instructions: HOST COMPUTER REQUIRED: Startool is not an ESP32-P4 program. On Linux, use your own StarCraft data and build/run the upstream startool extractor using the steps in pax-modules/upstream/retroesp32/GUS_GAME_RECIPES.md (Recipe 1). Then run python3 ~/code/pax/pax-recipe/tools/prepare_stargus_sd.py /path/to/converted-stargus-tree. Copy the complete prepared tree, including media/, to /sd/roms/stargus/. Recipe PAX only creates the SD folders and shows these instructions; it does not run startool. Graphics and sound remain as SD data, not in the store executable.
